blogs.name: Entrepreneurs.ng
blogs.verificationMethod: Same feed already verified for Tailoring & Fashion Design (skill_01) — cross-tagged here because it has multiple real, specific POS business articles: 'Best POS Agent Banking Platforms in Nigeria', a full 'OPay POS Business' how-to guide, and general POS-business coverage.

notes: First category in the Businesses section — a completely fresh start with no prior curriculum.md research or skills overlap to build on. Genuine finding: despite POS/agent banking being one of Nigeria's most common small businesses (655M+ transactions/₦4.7 trillion in 2020 alone per NIBSS), there is no dedicated YouTube channel teaching the business side — content is entirely in article form, across many real, legitimate blogs (Sycamore, Legit.ng, dockaysworld.com.ng, ErrandPay, SupplySmart) beyond just Entrepreneurs.ng. This likely reflects that a POS business has a low barrier/complexity (buy a machine, register, start), so there's less demand for extensive tutorial content compared to skilled trades. Sycamore's blog (blog.sycamore.ng, a real fintech company) looked promising but its RSS feed could not be confirmed this round.
